text: It's also worth noting that although there's a blockade on the Strait of Hormuz, there's lots of land routes that provide resupply in to Iran. So they're not short of getting kids and equipment in. The other point I would make is um, and this is not being a smart ass about the whole situation. But when I was in the military, we used to war game this sort of scenario. I have played Iran in those war games.
